summary: Devon Energy filed an 8-K (Items 7.01, 8.01, 9.01) on May 21, 2026, reporting its $2.6 billion acquisition of 16,300 net undeveloped Delaware Basin acres (Lea/Eddy Counties, NM) at ~$161,500/acre via the BLM Oil and Gas Lease Sale. The asset adds ~400 net locations (2-mile laterals) with 87.5% NRI and 10-year terms, enhancing Permian inventory. No board recommendation or advisor is named; consideration was cash, funded presumably internally. The deal is accretive to NAV. Watch for operational integration and regulatory updates from BLM; risk-arb is minimal as it is a completed asset purchase.
